in_arabic.name: شهناز
in_arabic.meaning: إسم يعني بالفخر و الجمال و الرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: شهناز هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل فارسي، يعني بالفخر و الجمال و الرقة. و قد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه يعني 'الملكة الجميلة' أو 'المرأة الجميلة التي تتفوق على غيرها في الجمال و الحسن'. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: شہناز
in_urdu.long_meaning: شہناز ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، جمال، فخر، تیز رفتار۔ یہ نام فارسی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور جمال کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ شہناز نام کی لڑکیوں کو خوبصورت، فخرومند اور جمیل سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: शहनाज़
in_hindi.long_meaning: शहनाज़ एक फ़ारसी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता, गर्व, तेज़ गति। यह नाम फ़ारसी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदरता और सौंदर्य की प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। शहनाज़ नाम की लड़कियों को सुंदर, गर्व से भरी और तेज़ समझा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: شهناز
in_pashto.long_meaning: شهناز د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې معنی یې ښایسته، ښکل، فخر، چټکتیا ده. دا نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د افغانستان په کلتور کې د ښکلا او جمال نښه په توګه کارول کېږي. شهناز نومې لارې کچې ښایسته، فخرونده او چټکې ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Shehnaz
in_english.long_meaning: Shehnaz is a Persian-originated name that signifies beauty, pride, and swiftness. Derived from Arabic roots, it is often associated with qualities like loveliness, nobility, and quickness. In Islamic tradition, Shehnaz symbolizes a person with a beautiful character, pride in their heritage, and a swift or agile nature. The name holds cultural significance across various Muslim communities, reflecting a blend of Persian and Arabic linguistic influences.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shehnaz, which originates from Persian and Arabic cultures, carries a rich meaning inspired by nature and beauty. It is particular to the Islamic culture due to its link to the story of Scheherazade, a legendary queen of the Arabian Nights. Scheherazade is renowned for her storytelling ability, saving her own life each night by sharing captivating tales with her husband, the Sultan of Baghdad, thus prolonging her life. The name Shehnaz communicates the beauty and allure that such a powerful and clever queen possessed. It also highlights the reverence for the natural world that is present in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shehnaz holds spiritual importance due to its symbolism of beauty, grace, and the power of storytelling. The beauty of nature, as reflected in the name, is seen as a divine creation that reminds us of the wonders of the universe. The name's association with Scheherazade speaks to the idea of our stories and the choices we make in life having the power to shape our lives and the lives of those around us. In Islamic spirituality, narrative and storytelling serve as a powerful tool to understand and connect with religious principles, as seen in the Quranic narratives and Hadith. Thus, the name Shehnaz embodies themes of protection, grace, and wisdom, encouraging us to live beautiful, purposeful lives.
